title: Kusanagi Nene — Sharp-Tongued And Unsociable〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He said to meet here, but he's not here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hey, hope I didn't keep you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You did. I was waiting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sorry about that. I almost ran into Tsukasa on the way here and had to shake him off. So, how can I help?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, you brought Robo-Nene along today?
Did anyone question you about it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No. I came to school earlier and hid it in an inconspicuous spot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Its arms aren't working very well.
Can you fix that for me? Without Robo-Nene, I...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's no trouble at all.
That's why I brought my tools to school today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? How did you do that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe, the hall monitor would have a fit if I'd brought them in openly, so I exercised some ingenuity to make them fit under my clothes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right... Well, do you think it can be fixed?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll take a look now. Just a moment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The arms, right? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The gears are... Ah, I see the problem now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry. The connections were a little loose, that's all. It should take no time at all to fix them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh. That's great.
Thanks for the help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I've been thinking of how to present the scenes in the script that Tsukasa came up with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you think about singing and breathing fire at the same time?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And who's going to be doing that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, of course, since he's the lead.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It was nice knowing you, Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah... Achoo!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember that scene where the prince puts the dragon to sleep by singing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. Though I doubt his loud and jarring singing can ever put anything to sleep...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You may be right.
So why don't you sing during that part instead?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There won't be any sound except for the actor's voice here. I want the audience to just focus on listening to the song.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, it's not set in stone yet since we have to discuss it with the others first. Perhaps you can simply keep that idea in the back of your mind for now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can I...use Robo-Nene for that part?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll leave that up to you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I've fixed it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah! Already?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I said it'd take no time at all, didn't I?
Here, try operating it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes. It's working fine now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Now, I'll be okay even if I have to sing...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, now that I've fixed the robot,
it's time for me to go look for Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder how he'll react to that idea from just now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui... You seem happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Really, is that how I come across to you?
Oh, isn't that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe, what impeccable timing.
Tsukasa! Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...
